step_1_sphere_block_size.claim: Syndra R authors a block of 3..7 per-sphere damage events; 3 is the count when no Dark Sphere is live.
step_1_sphere_block_size.conclusion: The wiki's own min/max rows pin the sphere count to exactly [3, 7]: 3 conjured + up to 4 grabbed live spheres. At fight start (t=0) no Dark Sphere exists, so an R cast that precedes any Q cast fires exactly 3 spheres -> a 3-event block.

step_2_event_stream_layout.syndra_damage_authoring_slots: Q, Q2 (2nd charge at 40+ splinters), W (magic; + bonus true damage at 60+ splinters), E, R (per-sphere block)
step_2_event_stream_layout.therefore: For E to sit at index 5 the five preceding events MUST include R's multi-sphere block (>=3 events); i.e. R is cast before E, and the block is small (3, or 4 with a single preceding Q). E at index 5 is fully consistent with the sourced 3-sphere minimum, e.g. R(0,1,2) + Q(3) + Q2-or-W(4) + E(5).
step_2_event_stream_layout.old_value_layout: R at index 5 is exactly the layout produced by the DEFAULT cast order Q,W,E,R: Q(0), W(1), E(2), then the R sphere block at (3,4,5,...) for any sphere count >= 3. E is at index 2 under the default order and can never reach index 5 there.

step_3_single_cast_constraint.claim: R cannot re-enter the stream later in the fight, so an 'R' at index 5 must be part of the single R block.
step_3_single_cast_constraint.basis: docs/math-foundations.md pins 'R casts exactly once per timed fight' / 'R single-cast'; independently, R's cooldown is 120/100/80 s, so even a 60 s window admits one cast. E, by contrast, has a 15 s cooldown -> casts at 0, 15, 30, 45 (4 casts) in a 60 s window, so E is a recurring event source.

step_4_discriminator.reasoning: The scenario id declares a CUSTOM cast order (the engine's default is DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER = Q,W,E,R, per data/worklists/f2-task.md; scenarios pinning a non-default order are an established pattern, e.g. Vladimir 'cast_order R,Q,W,E'). The old leaf value (R at index 5) is precisely the fingerprint of the DEFAULT order layout - the R sphere block starting at index 3 after Q,W,E. The new value (E at index 5) is the fingerprint of an order in which R fires before E with a minimal 3-sphere block (the sourced count when no Dark Sphere is live, which is exactly the case when R leads the rotation). A custom-order scenario whose golden reproduces the default-order layout is the inconsistent one.
step_4_discriminator.conclusion: E is the value consistent with a honoured non-default cast order plus the wiki-pinned 3-sphere minimum; R at index 5 reproduces the default-order layout the scenario is named to avoid.

limits_and_uncertainty: The scenario's own configuration (its cast_order list, splinters value, r_spheres option, fight length - whether '60' is 60 seconds or 60 Splinters of Wrath) lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/, tests/), so the cast order could not be read, only inferred from the scenario id and the default-order fingerprint.

Both readings of '60' (60 s timed fight; 60 splinters enabling W's bonus true damage) were worked through and both converge on the same layout conclusion: E can only reach index 5 behind an R sphere block, and R at index 5 is the default-order arrangement.
No sourced number in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md contradicts E as the index-5 source; the verdict is therefore 'new_value_correct' at moderate (not certain) confidence rather than 'both_wrong'.
